  rtAudienceScore = 78,
  verdict = 'miss',
  cardMarketContent = '## Eternals: Star-Studded Cast, Divisive Reception

Eternals (2021) featured one of the most star-studded casts in MCU history, directed by Oscar-winner Chloe Zhao. Despite mixed critical reception, the massive cast creates significant autograph card potential.

### Key Sets

The **2021 Upper Deck Eternals** set features autographs from an incredible ensemble including Angelina Jolie, Salma Hayek, Kit Harington, and Barry Keoghan.

### Market Trends

Angelina Jolie (Thena) autograph cards carry massive Hollywood star premium regardless of the film''s reception. Barry Keoghan cards surged after his breakout in Saltburn and The Batman. Kit Harington (Dane Whitman/Black Knight) cards are speculative investments for his future MCU role.',
  keyCards = '- **Angelina Jolie as Thena Autograph** — A-list Hollywood legend ($4,000+)
- **Barry Keoghan as Druig Auto** — Breakout star ($2,000+)
- **Kit Harington as Dane Whitman Auto** — Future Black Knight ($1,200+)
- **Salma Hayek as Ajak Autograph** — Hollywood icon ($1,500+)
- **Richard Madden as Ikaris Auto** — Game of Thrones crossover appeal ($800+)
- **Kumail Nanjiani as Kingo Auto** — Comedy star MCU card ($500+)',
  content = '## The Eternals Saga

Eternals was the MCU''s most ambitious and divisive film. Oscar-winning director Chloe Zhao brought her signature visual style to a 7,000-year epic spanning human civilization. While critics were split, the film introduced fascinating cosmic mythology and a massive ensemble that will pay dividends in future MCU stories.

## The Legacy

- **Chloe Zhao** — First Oscar-winning director to helm an MCU film, bringing arthouse sensibility
- **The Celestials** — Introduced the cosmic gods who created the universe, including Arishem
- **Dane Whitman** — Kit Harington''s character is set up as the future Black Knight
- **Representation** — Featured the MCU''s first deaf superhero (Makkari) and first on-screen same-sex couple
- **Divisive Reception** — Lowest RT critics score in MCU history at 47%, but 78% audience score

## Fun Facts

- Chloe Zhao insisted on filming on location around the world rather than using green screens
- The film spans 7,000 years of human history, the longest timeline in any MCU film
- Barry Keoghan was relatively unknown when cast but became a massive star shortly after
- Kit Harington''s post-credits scene with the Ebony Blade was voiced by Mahershala Ali as Blade
- Kumail Nanjiani underwent a dramatic physical transformation for the role, gaining significant muscle

## Viewing Context

Eternals is the **third Phase 4 film** and largely stands alone from the rest of the MCU, though it explains why the Eternals didn''t intervene in Thanos''s Snap. The post-credits scenes introduce Starfox (Harry Styles) and set up Dane Whitman''s transformation into Black Knight. The Celestials and Eternals mythology connects to the broader cosmic MCU.',
  metaDescription = 'Eternals (2021) — Chloe Zhao directed, star-studded cast, $402M box office, and trading card market analysis for Marvel collectors.',
  keywords = 'Eternals, MCU Phase 4, Angelina Jolie, Barry Keoghan, Kit Harington, Chloe Zhao, Celestials, trading cards, Marvel cards',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Eternals cards autograph',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Eternals on Disney+?","answer":"Yes, Eternals (2021) is available on Disney+. It was directed by Oscar-winner Chloe Zhao and features one of the MCU''s most star-studded casts."},{"question":"Why did Eternals get bad reviews?","answer":"Eternals received a 47% critics score on RT — the lowest in MCU history — with critics citing pacing issues and an overstuffed cast. However, audiences were more favorable at 78%, appreciating the ambition and visual style."},{"question":"What Eternals cards are valuable?","answer":"Angelina Jolie Thena autos ($4,000+) carry A-list premium. Barry Keoghan Druig autos ($2,000+) surged after his breakout roles. Kit Harington Black Knight autos ($1,200+) are speculative investments for his future MCU role."},{"question":"Will there be an Eternals 2?","answer":"While no sequel has been officially announced, several characters are expected to return. Kit Harington''s Dane Whitman/Black Knight setup and the Starfox introduction suggest future appearances."},{"question":"Who is Dane Whitman?","answer":"Dane Whitman (Kit Harington) is Sersi''s human boyfriend who is revealed to be connected to the Ebony Blade — a cursed weapon that transforms him into the Black Knight, a major Marvel Comics character."}]',
  status = 'published',
  updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE slug = 'eternals-2021'
